high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from a news segment titled "60 MINUTES." The text discusses the exclusivity and high demand for Hermès Birkin handbags. It mentions that the Birkin is the most coveted and costly handbag in the world, retailing around $9,000 and fetching upwards of hundreds of thousands at auction. Despite the high price, the stores typically do not have any Birkins to sell due to the overwhelming demand. The image features a close-up photograph of a Hermès Birkin handbag displayed on a glass shelf. The bag is white with a beige interior and adorned with colorful embroidered designs,
